200.description: OIDC Standard Claims for the bearer subject

schema.description:
The `GET /oauth/userinfo` claims document (the live identity
projection: subject + live roles/groups/scopes).

client_id.description: The token's client id (present on delegated/M2M subjects).

email.description: The user's email (absent when the subject is a client).

sub.description:
The subject id (the BFF client id on delegated tokens: the
`token_tp`/`act` chain is not leaked).

schema.title: OidcClaims
